message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time market data. To find the most up‑to‑date gold price in the United States, you can check one of the following reliable sources:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **Bloomberg** | Search “Gold price” on Bloomberg.com or use the Bloomberg terminal if you have access. |
| **Reuters** | Visit Reuters.com and look for the “Gold” section under commodities. |
| **Kitco** | Go to kitco.com/price-charts/gold and view the live chart. |
| **Investing.com** | Navigate to Investing.com → Commodities → Gold. |
| **Yahoo Finance** | Search “XAUUSD” (gold vs. U.S. dollar) on finance.yahoo.com. |
| **Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)** | FRED provides historical gold prices; the latest data point is usually a few days old. |

If you need the price for a specific time (e.g., closing price on a particular date), most of these sites allow you to view historical charts and download the data. Let me know if you’d like help interpreting the data or understanding how gold prices are quoted!
